posts.title: Python Dependencies Need Integrity Checks
bullets: Pin exact versions for reproducible installs.
Use pip --require-hashes for every direct and transitive dependency.
Prefer --only-binary :all: where compatible; isolate install jobs from secrets.
posts.caption:
A pinned Python dependency is not necessarily integrity-verified. Use pip --require-hashes with hashes for every direct and transitive package, prefer wheels where practical, and isolate CI installs from production secrets.
